name: Chicago 311 Service Requests
version_note: Rolling dataset (Socrata id v6vf-nfxy). Per a web-search summary it covers requests created after the new 311 system launch on 2018-12-18 plus some legacy-system records (a LEGACY_RECORD column). Pin pulls via RETRIEVAL.json.

data_access.method: Socrata SODA API (JSON/CSV) or bulk export

license.name: City of Chicago Terms of Use (Data Portal)

evidence.note: A snippet referred to 'City of Chicago Terms of Service' as the licence and said the dataset has 39 columns including duplicate and parent-request fields (names given as isDuplicate / parentServiceRequestNumber in the snippet; actual column names UNCONFIRMED).
Official page could not be fetched: the authoring sandbox's network egress proxy blocks this host.

license.attribution: Source: City of Chicago Data Portal — 311 Service Requests (v6vf-nfxy). Exact attribution/terms wording must be taken from the portal's terms.
notes: The terms URL above is the commonly referenced data disclaimer page and was NOT verified; confirm the applicable terms on the dataset page.

subset_used: To be selected (suggest: a bounded date window; include rows with duplicate/parent fields populated for the fusion evaluation).
restrictions: Terms not yet read at the primary source.
Do not commit raw or prepared rows.
Duplicate flags are agency-assigned and may be noisy; do not describe them as human-verified ground truth.

supports.how: If the file carries agency-assigned duplicate/parent-request links, they give REAL duplicate pairs to evaluate the geospatial + temporal + category signals and to re-fit the combined-score weights on real spatio-temporal behaviour.
caveats: No citizen narrative text: the semantic signal cannot be evaluated here.
Negatives are sampled (nearby same-type unlinked requests) and may include undetected duplicates, so precision is a conservative lower bound.

supports.how: Real spatio-temporal data for hotspot/recurrence/baseline validation.
Resolution-time distributions per service type for SLA/age sanity checks.
Realistic seed data for copilot demos.

does_not_support.why: Service-type fields, not narrative text (confirm with `cli profile`).
No before/after media in the tabular data.

known_limitations: Schema may evolve; column names must be confirmed against the live file.
privacy_notes: Street addresses may be present; the adapter does not read address columns.
expected_schema_notes: Expected (not verified) columns: sr_number, sr_type, owner_department, status, created_date, closed_date, latitude, longitude, plus duplicate/parent/legacy fields under UNCONFIRMED names. The adapter resolves by alias and fails loudly.
role_summary: Optional external source for real duplicate-pair behaviour (not Indian).
